# HDS consumer skill

This skill describes @hirobius/design-system 0.32.0.

## Upgrading

Run `npx @hirobius/design-system@latest upgrade --check` first. It changes nothing; it exits 1 when the project is behind or still uses a removed name. Then run `npx @hirobius/design-system@latest upgrade`: it runs the codemods, bumps the dependency, installs, typechecks, refreshes this skill in `.claude/skills/hds-consumer/`, and lists what is left to do by hand. Every removed or renamed name with its replacement is in `node_modules/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/upgrade.txt`; the guide is `UPGRADING.md`.

## Deprecated: do not use in new code

Still exported until the release named, but do not write new code with them:

- `Blockquote.size` (removed in 1.0.0): Blockquote has one size (md); the size prop, including sm and lg, still renders as before until removed.
- `Box-sx-layout-names` (removed in 1.0.0): Box sx spacing names 'tight', 'normal', 'inset' and 'spacious' still work but are deprecated, and a development build warns once for each; use 'sm' to 'xl' instead.
- `CardMetric` (removed in 1.0.0): Card.Metric is deprecated and still works; no replacement is planned, so compose a Card with the type roles (caption label, display or title value).
- `Divider.strong` (removed in 1.0.0): Divider's strong prop, deprecated since before 0.16.0, still works; use variant="strong" instead.
- `InlineCode.compact` (removed in 1.0.0): InlineCode's compact prop, deprecated since before 0.16.0, still works; use density="compact" instead.
- `MetricTile` (removed in 1.0.0): MetricTile is deprecated and still works; no replacement is planned, so compose a Card with the type roles (caption label, display or title value).
- `MetricTiles` (removed in 1.0.0): MetricTiles is deprecated and still works; no replacement is planned, so compose a Card with the type roles (caption label, display or title value).
- `Stack-gap-layout-names` (removed in 1.0.0): Stack gap names 'tight', 'normal', 'inset' and 'spacious' still work and do not warn yet, but are removed in 1.0.0, and Stack names no replacement until then.
- `Stat` (removed in 1.0.0): Stat is deprecated and still works; no replacement is planned, so compose a Card with the type roles (caption label, display or title value).
- `StatusTile` (removed in 1.0.0): StatusTile still works until 1.0.0; replace it with <Card padding="item" className="border-0"><Card.Row trailing={trailing}><Card.RowTitle>{title}</Card.RowTitle> plus one <Card.RowNote> per note, and drop tone, which StatusTile never painted.
- `Text-variants` (removed in 1.0.0): The Text variants heading1, heading2, heading3, technical, eyebrow, badge, docLede, docBody, docSmall and docCode still work but are deprecated; use title, mono, caption, body or ui instead.
- `bg-[color:var(--semantic-color-feedback-bg-warning)]`, `border-[color:var(--semantic-color-feedback-warning)]/40`, `data-[highlighted]:text-foreground`, `data-[state=checked]:text-foreground`, `group-hover:opacity-100`, `h-3.5`, `max-w-2xl`, `p-16`, `pb-8`, `pt-1`, `sm:inline-block`, `sm:text-4xl`, `text-[color:var(--semantic-color-feedback-warning)]`, `text-muted-foreground/70`, `transition-[transform,opacity]`, `w-3.5` (removed in 1.0.0): Sixteen Tailwind utilities that only HDS's deleted internal files used, such as pt-1 and max-w-2xl, still ship in styles.css and tokens.css until 1.0.0, so a page that relies on HDS's compiled CSS for them should generate them with its own Tailwind.
- `hds.density` (removed in 1.0.0): hds.density still works but is deprecated; use hds.semantic.space.scale one step down, so density.sm becomes scale.xs.
- `typeStyles-aliases` (removed in 1.0.0): The hds.typeStyles keys from before the ramp (h1 to h3, heading1 to heading3, eyebrow, badge, micro, technical, small, label and the rest) and hds.semantic.typography label, labelDescriptive and labelTechnical still work but are deprecated; use display, title, body, ui, caption or mono instead.

Deprecated design tokens are not listed: the `hds/no-deprecated-token` lint rule flags each use and names its replacement.

## Install and import

Install `@hirobius/design-system`, import core components from the root barrel (`import { Button } from '@hirobius/design-system'`) and the pattern-tier components from `@hirobius/design-system/patterns` (`import { Page } from '@hirobius/design-system/patterns'`), and load one stylesheet once at the app root. Add `import '@hirobius/design-system/fonts.css'` only if you want the HDS brand fonts (optional; skip it to bring your own).

Subpath exports:

- `@hirobius/design-system/tokens.css`
- `@hirobius/design-system/styles.css`
- `@hirobius/design-system/fonts.css`
- `@hirobius/design-system/variables.css`
- `@hirobius/design-system/static.css`
- `@hirobius/design-system/tokens`
- `@hirobius/design-system/cn`
- `@hirobius/design-system/manifest`
- `@hirobius/design-system/contexts`
- `@hirobius/design-system/form`
- `@hirobius/design-system/mui`
- `@hirobius/design-system/brand`
- `@hirobius/design-system/scroll`
- `@hirobius/design-system/patterns`
- `@hirobius/design-system/icons`
- `@hirobius/design-system/eslint-plugin`
- `@hirobius/design-system/stats.json`
- `@hirobius/design-system/tailwind-preset`

## Core set

The 47 components of the ratified core set (`core: true` in the manifest): brand-neutral and composable. Compose a screen from these first; reach for the rest of the allow-list, or `@hirobius/design-system/patterns` for composed product surfaces, only when none fits.

- **Actions:** `Button`
- **Display:** `Avatar`, `Card`, `EmptyState`, `Field`, `Icon`, `Kbd`, `Table`, `Timeline`
- **Feedback:** `Alert`, `Badge`, `Progress`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`, `ToastProvider`
- **Inputs:** `Checkbox`, `Combobox`, `Input`, `Radio`, `SegmentedControl`, `Select`, `Slider`, `Tag`, `Textarea`, `Toggle`
- **Layout:** `Box`, `Container`, `Disclosure`, `Divider`, `Grid`, `Stack`, `Surface`
- **Navigation:** `Breadcrumb`, `InlineLink`, `NavList`, `Pagination`, `Tabs`
- **Overlays:** `CommandPalette`, `Dialog`, `Menu`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`
- **Theming:** `HdsRouterProvider`, `HdsThemeProvider`
- **Typography:** `MetaLine`, `Text`
- **Utility:** `VisuallyHidden`

## Allow-list: components you may import

Components you may import from `@hirobius/design-system`. Providers, hooks and helpers documented in `docs/CONSUMING.md` (for example `HdsThemeProvider`, `useHdsTheme`, `cn`) are also public. If a need is not covered, route it upstream instead of hand-rolling it.

### Actions

- `Button` — Triggers an action when activated.
- `ThemeToggle` — One-button light/dark switch with a sun-to-moon morph.

### Display

- `Avatar` — Circular avatar.
- `AvatarGroup` — Renders up to `max` overlapping avatars followed by a `+N` overflow chip.
- `Card` — Card — a raised surface with slot anatomy: header, body, footer, and a row for a titled status.
- `CardBody` — Card — surface container with slot anatomy (12d-card-anatomy).
- `CardDescription` — Card — surface container with slot anatomy (12d-card-anatomy).
- `CardFacts` — Card.Facts — a wrapping caption row of icon + label facts, as a list.
- `CardFooter` — Card — surface container with slot anatomy (12d-card-anatomy).
- `CardHeader` — Card — surface container with slot anatomy (12d-card-anatomy).
- `CardProgress` — Card — surface container with slot anatomy (12d-card-anatomy).
- `CardRow` — Card.Row — a title with muted notes and a trailing slot, inside a Card.
- `CardRowNote` — Card.RowNote — one muted caption line under the row's title; repeat it for more.
- `CardRowTitle` — Card.RowTitle — the row's title, at the ui role.
- `CardSource` — Card.Source — the entity's origin on one row: avatar, name and time.
- `CardTitle` — Card — surface container with slot anatomy (12d-card-anatomy).
- `EmptyState` — EmptyState — consistent no-data placeholder for lists, grids, and sections.
- `Field` — Caption label paired with a value — used in metadata grids and read-only forms.
- `Icon` — Icon — semantic icon wrapper for Lucide icons.
- `InlineCode` — InlineCode — inline code chip for token paths, file paths, and code-adjacent prose.
- `Kbd` — Renders a keyboard key or shortcut token, e.g. `<Kbd>⌘K</Kbd>`.
- `MetadataList` — Renders object metadata as a semantic `<dl>` of term/description pairs.
- `StatusListItem` — Status dot + title row with optional muted notes and trailing slot (e.g. badge).
- `Table` — Table - structured data table primitive for documentation and compact UI matrices.
- `Timeline` — The timeline itself.
- `TimelineItem` — One event on a Timeline.
- `Timestamp` — Presents a date/time with a machine-readable `dateTime` for accessibility.

### Feedback

- `Alert` — Alert - compact feedback surface with contextual severity.
- `Badge` — Compact metadata/status chip.
- `Callout` — Tone-driven tinted callout for notes, quotes, hypotheses — the same feedback fill language as Alert, without Alert's icon or status role.
- `Progress` — Linear bar or circular ring.
- `Skeleton` — Decorative loading placeholder.
- `Spinner` — Indeterminate spinner.
- `ToastProvider` — Provider + viewport for the toast system.

### Inputs

- `Checkbox` — Checkbox — custom-drawn checkbox with check / indeterminate glyph.
- `Combobox` — Combobox — searchable single- or multi-select (Popover + filtered listbox).
- `Composer` — Composer — prompt and capture box that grows with its text and folds long pastes into cards.
- `Input` — Input — text field primitive with label, helper, and error slots.
- `Radio` — Radio — radio button with animated selection indicator.
- `SegmentedControl` — SegmentedControl " segmented selection input for compact mutually-exclusive choices.
- `Select` — Select — dropdown selector built on Radix Select (ADR-001 Radix convention).
- `Slider` — Slider — range slider with label and value display.
- `Tag` — Tag — interactive filter and category chip.
- `Textarea` — Textarea — multi-line text field primitive with label, helper, and error slots.
- `Toggle` — Toggle — boolean on/off toggle with animated thumb.
- `TokenField` — TokenField — a multi-line text field whose tokens, such as `[Name]`, are atomic chips.

### Layout

- `Board` — Status columns that sit side by side from tablet width and stack in order, first column on top, below it.
- `BoardColumn` — One status column: a heading with the title and a count, then its items.
- `Box` — Box — polymorphic layout primitive with a token-first `sx` engine.
- `Container` — Container — semantic width-constrained layout.
- `Disclosure` — Disclosure - compact disclosure surface for optional explanatory content.
- `Divider` — Divider — semantic separator between content regions.
- `Grid` — Grid — responsive grid composition primitive.
- `Pin` — Pin — sticky-pin an element within its scroll region.
- `Sidebar` — Sidebar — fixed-width rail beside fluid content, no media query.
- `Stack` — Stack — one-dimensional layout primitive.
- `Surface` — Surface — governed inset surface primitive.
- `Switcher` — Switcher — flips a row to a column below a width threshold, no media query.

### Navigation

- `Breadcrumb` — Breadcrumb trail.
- `InlineLink` — InlineLink ” inline navigation and external-link primitive for body copy.
- `NavList` — A vertical list of rows (links, or buttons that select in place), one marked current.
- `NavListItem` — One row of a NavList.
- `Pagination` — Paged navigation with first/last anchors, sibling pages, and ellipses.
- `Tabs` — The tab set itself.
- `TabsContent` — Tabs — Radix-backed underline tabs (Root, List, Trigger, Content).
- `TabsList` — The tab strip.
- `TabsTrigger` — Tabs — Radix-backed underline tabs (Root, List, Trigger, Content).

### Overlays

- `AlertDialog` — AlertDialog root + parts.
- `CommandPalette` — CommandPalette — ⌘K search and command box: a modal search field over grouped results.
- `Dialog` — Tagged per-export, not on the file block: this module exports ten components and a file-level @figma would hand all ten this one node.
- `DialogClose` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `DialogContent` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `DialogDescription` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `DialogFooter` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `DialogHeader` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `DialogOverlay` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `DialogPortal` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `DialogTitle` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `DialogTrigger` — Dialog — modal dialog (shadcn baseline, compound parts).
- `Menu` — Menu root + parts.
- `Popover` — Popover root + parts.
- `Sheet` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetAction` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetActions` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetClose` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetContent` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetDescription` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetFooter` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetHeader` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetTitle` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `SheetTrigger` — Sheet — a bottom drawer on phones, the centred dialog from `sm` up (hds#690).
- `Tooltip` — Tooltip root.

### Typography

- `Blockquote` — A quoted passage; pass `cite` for the source URL and `attribution` for a byline.
- `MetaLine` — Secondary facts on one line ("Acme Cloud · Remote").
- `Text` — Text — polymorphic typography primitive spanning the full HDS type ramp.

### Utility

- `VisuallyHidden` — Renders its children off-screen (Tailwind `sr-only`) so they are announced by screen readers without occupying visual space — e.g. a text label for an icon-only control.

## Patterns: import from `@hirobius/design-system/patterns`

The pattern-tier components (screen shells, page sections, feeds, rails, pickers) are not in the root barrel: import them from the subpath, for example `import { Page } from '@hirobius/design-system/patterns'`.

### Actions

- `DestructiveSection` — Titled danger zone, a danger `Callout` (the shared feedback fill, no border of its own) holding a title, an explanation, and one danger `Button` that opens an `AlertDialog`.
- `FormActions` — Form footer with one fixed order: destructive (far left, if any), then secondary, then primary last and right-most.

### Display

- `AssetImg` — AssetImg - responsive asset frame with fallback placeholder handling.
- `CodeBlock` — CodeBlock - code display with copy button and optional collapsible toggle.
- `DataTableSection` — Section heading and toolbar over a `Table`.

### Feedback

- `AsyncState` — One wrapper for the four states of async content: `loading` (skeleton rows plus a polite status line that turns into "Still trying…" after `slowAfterMs`), `error` (a danger `Alert` and a Retry `Button`, with offline wording when the browser reports no connection), `empty` (your node) and `ready` (children).
- `ErrorPattern` — ErrorPattern - governed recovery surface for routed application errors.

### Inputs

- `Form` — Styled `<form>` with consistent vertical field rhythm.
- `FormField` — Label + description + error wrapper that wires the a11y relationships onto its single child control via cloneElement.
- `FormFieldShell` — Presentational label + control slot + helper/error markup.

### Layout

- `AppShell` — AppShell — the app frame for web apps: header, sidebar, main and an optional aside (hds#875).
- `Page` — Page — standard page shell.
- `PageHeader` — Screen header: breadcrumb slot, the title at the one canonical page-title size (`heading2`), a metadata row above the title, a status slot and an actions slot.

### Motion

- `Reveal` — Reveal — reveal-on-scroll primitive via CSS scroll-driven animation.

## How to lay out a screen

1. `Page` (from `@hirobius/design-system/patterns`; or `Container` for a full-bleed, non-page surface, with a `Box` inside it for a horizontal gutter) for the outermost width constraint. Never import `Container` directly inside `src/app/pages/**` — use `Page`, which wraps it and owns vertical rhythm.
2. `Stack` (vertical rhythm between sections) or `Grid` (two-dimensional/column layout) for the structural skeleton. One section = one Section/Stack — never add a second wrapper to fake a section boundary.
3. Reach for a named layout primitive before hand-rolling flex/grid math for a common intent: `Stack direction="row" wrap="wrap"` (wrapping row of same-ish things), `Sidebar` (fixed-width rail + fluid content, no media query), `Switcher` (row that flips to a column below a threshold, no media query). A full-height shell with a centered main region, an aspect-ratio-locked media box or a negative margin that escapes a parent padding is a `Box` with `style` (not `sx`, which applies on the client only).
4. `Surface` for any background-bearing, padded wrapper (card, panel, inset). Never a raw element with backgroundColor + padding hand-rolled inline.
5. Use the screen patterns (`@hirobius/design-system/patterns`) for the parts every screen repeats: `PageHeader` once at the top (breadcrumb, `heading2` title, status, actions), `MetricTiles` for any row of headline numbers, `FormActions` for a form footer (primary right-most and last in DOM order, destructive on the far left), `DataTableSection` for a titled table (toolbar slot, consumer row actions, empty state, scrolls on narrow widths without a caller `minWidth`), and `DestructiveSection` last for an irreversible action (danger button, then an `AlertDialog` confirm). A row of headline numbers is always `MetricTiles`; `Stat`, `Card.Metric` and `StatusTile` answer other needs (see "Pick By Need" in `llms.txt`). Pick between `Card` and `Surface` with the "Which one, when" table in `DESIGN.md`.
6. `Box` with `style` (or `sx`) is used last, only for genuinely one-off layout that no named primitive covers (prefer `style` over `sx`, as `sx` applies on the client only). `sx` spacing/color keys must be HDS token keys, never raw hex or px.

Never:

- No inline margins on children to fake spacing between siblings — gap/spacing on the parent (Stack/Grid/Switcher/Sidebar) owns rhythm, not margin on the child.
- No raw px or hex values in any layout or color prop — every spacing value comes from the semantic gap scale (`tight | normal | inset | spacious`, or a component/subgrid step) and every color comes from a `semantic.color.*` token.
- No repeated outlined cards as the default structure for roadmap/status/process/overview UI — use open bands, dividers, rails, disclosures, and whitespace instead.
- No primitive spacing: never a `primitive.space.*` step, `--primitive-space-*` var, `hds.space.px*` or numeric Tailwind spacing class (`p-4`, `gap-2`) — use `semantic.space.*` (`p-surface-padding`, `gap-scale-md`, `var(--semantic-space-scale-*)`) or the `xs…xl` keys. `hds/no-primitive-spacing` enforces it.
- Spacing rhythm: inner padding ≤ outer gap; a nested surface steps down one level (surface.padding → `sm` → `xs`) or takes `padding="none"`; sibling cards share one padding.

## Do and don't

- Use tokens only. No raw hex or px in `style`, `className` or `Box` `sx`; the lint rules below enforce this.
- Never guess a token name: run `pnpm exec hds-tokens search <name or words>` first; it says whether the name exists and lists the nearest real ones.
- Size vs space: `semantic.size.*` is an element's own width or height; `semantic.space.*` is the gap or padding between and inside elements.
- No inline margins on children to fake sibling spacing; the parent layout primitive owns the gap.
- Use an allow-listed HDS component where one exists instead of hand-rolling it.
- Keep app-local tokens and styles under your own `--<prefix>-*` prefix, never inside DS-owned namespaces (`--primitive-*`, `--semantic-*`, `--component-*`, `--role-*`, `--hds-*`; `data-hds`, `data-theme`, `data-tenant`).
- Re-theme through the brand bridge (`@hirobius/design-system/brand`) or by selecting a shipped direction with `data-tenant`; never by overriding DS tokens directly.
- Route gaps upstream: a missing component or token is an issue and PR against HDS, not a downstream patch.
- Mark the HDS scope with `data-hds` on `<html>`, `<body>` or a wrapper, and on portal containers for overlays that render into `document.body`.

## What you may select on

In tests and styles, select HDS elements only by:

- Role and accessible name, as a screen reader meets them: `getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' })`.
- ARIA states such as `aria-checked`, `aria-selected`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-disabled`.
- The `data-*` attributes a component lists in the manifest's `publicDataAttributes`, such as `data-state`, `data-variant`, `data-size`, `data-tone` and `data-slot`. Not `data-hds-*`, which are internal, or `data-radix-*`, which belong to Radix.
- The `hds-*` classes and the manifest's `publicClasses`, which the CSS contract tracks.
- Never other class names, ids, tag names or how elements nest: those change without an upgrade step.

The `data-*` attributes each component renders for you to select on:

- `AsyncState`: `data-crossfade-view`, `data-slot`, `data-status`
- `Avatar`: `data-size`
- `Badge`: `data-tone`
- `Button`: `data-crossfade-label`, `data-hover-effect`, `data-pressed`, `data-size`, `data-slot`, `data-tone`, `data-variant`
- `Card`: `data-bordered`, `data-format`, `data-interactive`, `data-padding`, `data-slot`, `data-tone`, `data-variant`
- `DataTableSection`: `data-slot`
- `DestructiveSection`: `data-slot`
- `Dialog`: `data-state`
- `Disclosure`: `data-state`
- `Divider`: `data-variant`
- `ErrorPattern`: `data-role`
- `Field`: `data-tone`
- `FormActions`: `data-slot`
- `Input`: `data-size`, `data-state`
- `Kbd`: `data-size`
- `Menu`: `data-state`
- `MetaLine`: `data-meta-separator`
- `NavList`: `data-slot`
- `PageHeader`: `data-slot`
- `Popover`: `data-state`
- `Progress`: `data-state`, `data-tone`, `data-variant`
- `Reveal`: `data-reveal`
- `SegmentedControl`: `data-state`
- `Select`: `data-state`
- `Sheet`: `data-state`
- `Skeleton`: `data-variant`
- `Spinner`: `data-size`
- `Table`: `data-slot`
- `Tabs`: `data-orientation`, `data-state`
- `Tag`: `data-active`, `data-dismissible`
- `Textarea`: `data-state`
- `ThemeToggle`: `data-theme-state`
- `Timeline`: `data-format`, `data-timeline-marker`, `data-tone`
- `TokenField`: `data-state`, `data-token`
- `Tooltip`: `data-state`

## Steps

Finish every task with the last step below.

1. Run `npx @hirobius/design-system@latest upgrade --check`; when it lists work, run `npx @hirobius/design-system@latest upgrade` and fix what it leaves under Do by hand.
2. Compose the screen from the allow-list and the `@hirobius/design-system/patterns` list, using the layout recipe.
3. Style with tokens only.
4. Add the lint plugin: `pnpm add -D "@hirobius/eslint-plugin-hds@github:hirobius/hds#path:/scripts/eslint-plugin-hds"`.
5. Enable `@hirobius/eslint-plugin-hds` with its `recommended` config, run ESLint, and fix every error before reporting done.
